images.filename: Greenbank Garden, Clarkston - geograph.org.uk - 1239323.jpg
images.caption: Greenbank Garden, Clarkston Stone bridge over a burn in the grounds of Greenbank Gardens, Clarkston. Not sure about the vertical stone 'post', with 'L'-shaped slots. There were others, with a different arrangement - all three on the same side, and some in pairs, wider apart than a normal gateway, with one of the pair with opposing, but simple, holes.
images.alt: Greenbank Garden, Clarkston Stone bridge over a burn in the grounds of Greenbank Gardens, Clarkston. Not sure about the vertical stone 'post', with 'L'-shaped slots.
